name: grudge-studio-npm
description: Grudge Studio quality system — bake, character, NPC/units, animator, engine, editor/deployer packages. Surface: forge.grudge-studio.com

scripts.build: npm run build -w @grudge-studio/core && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/asset-resolver && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/assets && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/character && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/units && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/bake && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/engine && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/stack && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/animator && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/deploy && npm run build -w @grudge-studio/sdk
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build && npm publish --workspaces --dry-run --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm publish --workspaces --access public
